# GrainHub Collector Coverage — Snapshot as of Cycle 39 (2026-11-19)

One-page snapshot of every price-source adapter in the FastAPI
registry: what it is, whether its `[sources]` toggle is on, when it
was last verified live, and how many rows it returned then. Row
counts are **at last check, not live prices** — no prices appear in
this document.

**How it was built:** the per-adapter table below was generated by a
script (`/tmp/cycle39_coverage.py`, not kept in the repo) that reads
the live registry (`app/services/source_registry.py`, 119 adapters)
and the real toggle loader (`app/services/source_toggles.py`), and
merges a hand-compiled last-verified map drawn from the cycle
reports (Cycles 1–39) and the price-source catalogue. The script
asserts every adapter is in the map — nothing is silently guessed.
"Last verified" means the last cycle that called the adapter (or
its page/proxy) live with one polite GET and recorded the row
count; "Cycle 1" means the Cycle 1 pilot work, not re-verified
since.

**Status vocabulary:** `live` — returned rows at last check.
`stale-watch` — returned rows, but the widget header was one day
behind (exemption list for any future freshness gate; count
unchanged). `closed` — verified to return nothing, toggled off.
`off` — toggle off or stub, never returns rows on schedule.
`pending` — never live-verified; needs a browser render check or
a decision first.

**Headline numbers (Cycle 38 audit, re-confirmed here):**
119 adapters; 102 toggle-enabled (seedable); 17 toggled off
(bunge, mapleview, 13 DTN, Heartland, Mulvane). Of the 102
enabled, 88 are `live` at last check, 5 are `stale-watch`
(they still return rows), 8 are Ontario Playwright collectors
verified in Cycle 1 only, and 1 (`andersons`) targets a legacy
DTN host never re-verified. The `north_gower` adapter is listed
below as one ordinary adapter among the 119 — public prices
only, no special treatment.

## Open items (from this snapshot)

1. **Collwest toggle / toml mismatch (minor).** The `collwest`
   adapter has no explicit `[sources]` toggle, so it defaults to
   enabled — but its `us_elevators_urls.toml` entry is disabled
   "as a record" (Cycle 17 audit). The collector itself is
   verified (Canadian, CAD, Cycle 3). Coordinator decision
   needed: add an explicit `collwest = false` toggle, or leave
   it seeding. No change made in Cycle 39.
2. **Andersons adapter targets a legacy DTN host, unverified.**
   `fetch_andersons_all` reads `dtn-api.andersonscanada.com/
   cash-bids/<slug>` — not the current GRAINweb site, whose
   facility tables are Barchart-licensed (Cycle 16) and are NOT
   what this adapter reads. It was built in Cycle 1 and never
   re-verified. One probe of the DTN endpoint would settle
   whether it still serves data, but it is a DTN host — do not
   probe it without the DTN licensed-feed decision.
3. **DTN family (13 adapters) — Playwright render checks
   pending.** All JS-only, all toggled off. Al-Corn and Sunrise
   first (classic `CashBidTable` shape).
4. **Ontario Playwright collectors (8 adapters)** —
   `agricharts`, `dg_global`, `ganaraska`, `glg`, `hensall`,
   `lac`, `snobelen`, `wanstead` — verified in Cycle 1 only.
   No live browser is available in overnight work, so they have
   not been re-verified since.
5. **Heartland / Mulvane — closed** (Cycle 25; default and
   filtered views return nothing, jsquote feed empty).
6. **Staleness watch — five widgets** (Chadbourn, Hamer,
   Hugoton 3370, Vilas-Walsh 3621, Almota): all exactly one day
   behind, all still returning rows. Exemption list for any
   future freshness gate; no further re-checks needed beyond
   the regular sweeps.
7. **Unreachable trio — re-checked Cycle 39, unchanged**
   (CVA 202/0 bytes, Landus 429/Vercel checkpoint, Mercer
   Landmark 522/0 bytes). See the catalogue Cycle 39 section.
   They are toml-only entries, not registry adapters, so they
   do not appear in the table above.
